# Build manual (skeleton)

**Status: not started. The manual is written in v0.3 from the completed CAD**, generated by
`scripts_code/generate_manual.py` (planned) with step images from `render_steps.py` (planned).

## Step format (LEGO Technic / IKEA style, not a textbook)
Every step has:
1. Step number
2. Parts required (part IDs from the BOM)
3. Hardware required
4. Tools required
5. One large isometric image with **new components highlighted**
6. Part IDs called out on the image
7. Orientation arrows
8. Important dimensions
9. A detail view if needed
10. An **inspection check** before continuing

**Never hide five fabrication operations inside one instruction.**

## Planned sections
- Safety (aluminum welding fumes, argon, cutting, lifting the shell)
- Welding practice and coupon tests (before any structural weld)
- Floor and tub
- Wall, roof, nose frames
- Jack and tie-down structures
- Skin bonding and riveting
- Insulation and interior panel
- Door, windows, sealing
- Rails and provisions
- Water test, weigh-in, first load on the truck

## Planned test plans (`manual/testing/`)
T-slot joint slip; T-slot joint rotation; frame racking; frame-plus-skin racking; adhesive bonding
(lap shear, peel, thermal cycle); riveted skin; representative corner waterproofing; roof/wall joint
waterproofing; jack attachment structure.
